description: The between operator of the Svelte 5 data grid's column filters. Number and date columns render From and To inputs in the column menu and keep rows whose value falls in the inclusive range; the same filter is set from code with api.setFilter('price', { operator: 'between', value: '100', valueTo: '500' }). api.getFilters() returns the same shape, so filter sets can be saved to localStorage or the URL, and onFiltersChange keeps a visible summary current.

faq.question: How do I filter a column to a range?
faq.answer: Open the column menu, pick Between and fill From and To. From code: api.setFilter(columnId, { operator: 'between', value, valueTo }). Both ends are inclusive.

faq.question: Can I persist the filters?
faq.answer: Yes. api.getFilters() returns every active filter as { operator, value, valueTo } keyed by column, which serializes cleanly; feed it back through api.setFilter on load.

faq.question: Why is there no Between for text columns?
faq.answer: A lexical range is rarely what users mean for strings, so text columns offer contains, equals, starts with, ends with, regex and the set operators instead.
